description: A DNS domain (zone) a saved DNS credential manages. Domain Names fields suggest it and the DNS challenge matches names to its credential; hosts and certificates keep plain names.

dns_credential_id.description: ID of the DNS credential that manages the domain; the domain's owner is the credential's owner

name.description: The domain in lower case ASCII (an internationalized name as punycode), without a trailing dot; it covers itself and every name below it

source.description: How the domain was added: typed in, or fetched from the DNS provider

credential.description: The DNS credential, without its values; only with `expand=credential`

owner.description: The user who owns the credential
